data.name: Snipers Lantern
data.description: You use your innate magic powers to target enemies and spot their weaknesses. You can use your dancing lights racial spell-like ability to create one orb of penetrating light. This light grants you a +2 insight bonus on all ranged attacks made against targets within 5 feet of the light's location. You can direct this light to a new location anywhere within the spell's range as a move action, otherwise the effect functions exactly like dancing lights. You can use this ability times per day.
